# YouTube Transcript API

Extract **YouTube captions, subtitles, and full transcript text** from any public video by **video ID** or **URL**. Built for **AI summarization**, **RAG pipelines**, search indexing, accessibility, and subtitle tools.

**100 free requests/month** on Basic — test in the playground in 30 seconds.

## Authentication

All requests go through RapidAPI. Include these headers:

- `X-RapidAPI-Key`: your RapidAPI key
- `X-RapidAPI-Host`: `get-youtube-transcript.p.rapidapi.com`

## Endpoint

### GET /transcript

Returns the transcript for a video.

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `video_id` | string | yes* | 11-character YouTube video ID |
| `url` | string | yes* | Full YouTube URL (alternative to video_id) |
| `languages` | string | no | Comma-separated language codes (default: `en`) |
| `format` | string | no | `json` (default), `text`, or `raw` |
*Provide either `video_id` or `url`.

## Example

```bash
curl "https://get-youtube-transcript.p.rapidapi.com/transcript?video_id=1M3Vdl6DRkU&format=json" \
  -H "X-RapidAPI-Key: YOUR_KEY" \
  -H "X-RapidAPI-Host: get-youtube-transcript.p.rapidapi.com"
```

## Response formats

- **json** — metadata plus `transcript` array with `text`, `start`, `duration`
- **text** — plain text, one line per cue
- **raw** — array of timed cues only

## Use cases

- Summarize long YouTube videos with LLMs
- Feed transcripts into vector DBs for RAG
- Build accessibility and caption tools
- Index video content for search

## Pricing

- **Basic**: 100 free requests/month
- **Ultra**: 100,000 requests/month ($9/mo)

## Health check

`GET /health` returns `{"status":"ok"}` when the service is running.
